subject: Starter MAP doc and proposed close tempo (GDoc share)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Linden <anna@clearwaterlabs.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter MAP doc and proposed close tempo (GDoc share)

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I’m attaching a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) starter and a short week‑0 slide stub to help your team map acceptance gates. The goal here is to propose a pragmatic 6‑week evaluation with clear technical and business checkpoints so procurement and your STO can sign off earlier.

Quick notes:
- Link to editable GDoc (preferred): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-map-starter
- Attached: MAP_Starter_Template_v1.gdoc, Week0_Playbook_Slides_v1.pptx, acceptance‑matrix.csv
- Proposed close tempo: 6 weeks, with milestones at week 1 (env + smoke), week 3 (integration + perf), week 5 (security & compliance artifacts), week 6 (stakeholder acceptance).

Ask: Could you skim the acceptance matrix and confirm whether the security evidence list is sufficient for your auditors (SOC/SLA items)? If not, happy to add a dedicated step. Also, what’s your preferred time for a 30‑min alignment next week to finalize owners?

I’ll follow up internally to capture any edits before we co‑author the doc.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555‑0198


--- Attachments: MAP_Starter_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc), Week0_Playbook_Slides_v1.pptx (presentation), acceptance-matrix.csv (CSV)

From: Anna Linden <anna@clearwaterlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Starter MAP doc and proposed close tempo (GDoc share)

Marissa —

Thanks for sending this over. I looked through the GDoc and acceptance matrix; really helpful structure. A couple of immediate items from our side:

1) Runway: Our legal/procurement team prefers a 4‑week vendor trial window rather than 6 to align with Q4 procurement cadence. Can we compress the milestones?
2) Security evidence: we need an explicit step to produce an internal data flow diagram and a short SOC 2 control mapping doc (our auditors asked for the mapping by name).
3) Ownership: Can you make the week‑0 owner column editable so we can add our internal POCs?

If you can update the doc with (2) and make the owner column editable, I’ll get procurement eyes on it ASAP. Also available for a 30‑min sync on Thursday 11:00am PT if that works for you.

Thanks — Anna
Anna Linden
Director, IT & Security | Clearwater Labs
anna@clearwaterlabs.com | (206) 555‑0124

Subject: Fwd: Starter MAP doc and proposed close tempo (GDoc share) — edits requested by Clearwater

Jasmine / Laura —

Forwarding Anna’s quick feedback. They want to: compress the MAP to a 4‑week runway, add an explicit "Security artifacts" step that yields a data flow diagram and SOC 2 control mapping, and make the owner column editable.

Can we update the GDoc today with these three items? My recommendation:
- Compress milestones: week 0 (env + onboarding), week 2 (integration + perf), week 4 (security artifacts + acceptance). Keep the acceptance matrix but move some lower‑priority items to a post‑trial backlog.
- Add a new section "Security evidence (deliverables)" with two bullets: DFD (diagram) and SOC 2 control mapping (1‑page table).
- Set the owner column permissions to editable and add a short note on expected POC roles (Dev lead, Security, Procurement).

If you agree I’ll push the edits and ping Anna with an updated link and a proposed Thursday 11:00am PT meeting invite. Also flagging: if we shorten to 4 weeks we should remove the week‑3 performance buffer — that increases risk but aligns to their procurement window. I’m fine with this if engineering is comfortable with an aggressive perf validation (Jasmine, your call).

Thanks —
Marissa

Anna —

Thanks for the quick review and the timing note. We made the requested edits and compressed the MAP to a 4‑week evaluation. High level changes:

- Milestones compressed: Week 0 (env + onboarding), Week 2 (integration + perf validation), Week 4 (security artifacts + stakeholder acceptance).
- New section added: "Security evidence (deliverables)" with: DFD (data flow diagram) and SOC 2 control mapping table.
- Acceptance matrix updated — low‑priority items moved to a post‑trial backlog tab in the doc.
- Owner column set to editable; please add your internal POCs in the owner column.

Updated links and attachments:
- GDoc (edited): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-map-starter?usp=sharing
- Acceptance CSV updated: acceptance‑matrix_v2.csv (attached)

I’ve tentatively scheduled a 30‑min alignment for Thursday 11:00am PT. Invite coming from my calendar — feel free to propose a different time.

Next steps:
1) Anna to add internal POCs to owner column.
2) Jasmine to lead perf validation plan and confirm feasibility of week‑2 targets by EOD Friday.
3) Laura to prepare the one‑page SOC 2 control mapping draft by next Tuesday.

If anything else is needed to get procurement eyes on it faster (pricing cadence or a short two‑slide summary for legal), we can include that in the Friday update.

Talk soon —
Marissa
